Las islas se miden por área en mm². No l: Islands are measured by area in mm². Do not confuse them with loose parts in the Mesh group, which are controlled by size in millimeters.
une vértices duplicados y elimina triáng: merges duplicate vertices and removes degenerate triangles and repeated faces. The summary shows what was fixed or whether the mesh was already clean.
elimina componentes pequeños según su ta: removes small components based on their size. Leave it at 0 to keep them, and check that increasing it does not remove a detail you want.
controla el porcentaje de geometría que: controls the percentage of geometry to keep: 100% keeps the mesh, and lowering it reduces the triangle count. Check the silhouette and color boundaries; too much simplification can remove details you want to print.
